answer: Hold each agent's earnings in escrow for several epochs while a lottery picks unpredictable auditors to re-check finished work, so a sybil farm never knows which identities face inspection. An auditor earns a bounty only by proving duplicate work or shared control, and honest agents release escrow untouched. Newcomers still find a canyon passage in: a willow seed of verified history grows into full rights with no insider invitation, while clones sharing fingerprints forfeit their escrow at once, their plume of fake identities collapsing before it spreads.
